quote: Uranus (also spelt Ouranos) is the personification of heaven and the sky in Greek mythology.

statement.id: Uranus atau Ouranos adalah personifikasi langit dalam mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: Uranus or Ouranos is the personification of the sky in Greek mythology.

quote: OURANOS (Uranus) was the primordial god (protogenos) of the sky.

statement.id: Uranus digolongkan sebagai dewa purba langit.
statement.en: Uranus is a primordial sky god.

quote: Gaia (Earth) gave birth to Uranus and chose him to be her equal.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Gaia melahirkan Uranus dan menjadikannya pasangannya.
statement.en: Gaia gave birth to Uranus and chose him as her equal.

quote: She lay with him, resulting in the birth of the twelve Titans, the three Cyclopes and the three Hecatoncheires.

statement.id: Gaia dan Uranus melahirkan para Titan, Cyclopes, dan Hecatoncheires.
statement.en: Gaia and Uranus parented the Titans, Cyclopes, and Hecatoncheires.

quote: Uranus hated his and Gaia's children and hid them deep beneath the earth so that they would stay out of his sight.

statement.id: Uranus menyembunyikan anak-anaknya di dalam bumi.
statement.en: Uranus hid his children within the earth.

quote: Gaia made a sickle out of grey adamant, gave it to Cronus, and hid him in her bed chamber.

statement.id: Gaia memberikan sabit kepada Cronus untuk melawan Uranus.
statement.en: Gaia gave Cronus a sickle to confront Uranus.

quote: Cronus took his chance and struck out with the sickle, castrating Uranus' genitals.

statement.id: Cronus mengebiri Uranus dengan sabit.
statement.en: Cronus castrated Uranus with the sickle.

quote: As the blood fell, it impregnated Gaia, who gave birth to the Erinyes (the Furies), the Giants and the Meliae (tree nymphs).

statement.id: Darah Uranus yang jatuh ke Gaia melahirkan Erinyes, para raksasa, dan Meliae.
statement.en: Uranus's blood falling on Gaia led to the birth of Erinyes, Giants, and Meliae.

quote: White foam surrounded it, and from it, the goddess Aphrodite was born in Cythera (Kythira).

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Aphrodite lahir dari buih di laut.
statement.en: In this account, Aphrodite was born from sea foam.

quote: His Roman counterpart is Caelus.

statement.id: Caelus adalah padanan Romawi Uranus.
statement.en: Caelus is Uranus's Roman counterpart.

quote: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid dome of brass, decorated with stars, whose edges descended to rest upon the outermost limits of the flat earth. Ouranos was the literal sky, just as his consort Gaia (Gaea) was the earth.

statement.id: Orang Yunani membayangkan langit sebagai kubah perunggu padat bertabur bintang yang tepinya bertumpu pada batas terjauh bumi yang datar; Ouranos adalah langit itu sendiri, sebagaimana pasangannya Gaia adalah bumi.
statement.en: The Greeks imagined the sky as a solid brass dome decorated with stars, its edges resting on the outermost limits of the flat earth; Ouranos was the literal sky, as his consort Gaia was the earth.

quote: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters. He locked the eldest of these--the giant Kyklopes (Cyclopes) and Hekatonkheires (Hecatoncheires)--away inside the belly of Earth.

statement.id: Ouranos dan Gaia memiliki dua belas putra dan enam putri; ia mengurung anak tertua, para Kyklopes dan Hekatonkheires yang raksasa, di dalam perut Bumi.
statement.en: Ouranos and Gaia had twelve sons and six daughters; he locked the eldest, the giant Cyclopes and Hecatoncheires, away inside the belly of Earth.

quote: Four of these positioned themselves at the corners of the world, ready to grasp their father as he descended to lie with Earth, while the fifth, Kronos (Cronus), took his place in the centre and there castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

statement.id: Menurut uraian ini, empat dari anak-anak itu berjaga di sudut dunia untuk menangkap ayah mereka, sementara Kronos di tengah mengebiri Ouranos dengan sabit adamantin.
statement.en: In this account four of the children took positions at the corners of the world to seize their father while Kronos, in the centre, castrated Ouranos with an adamantine sickle.

quote: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titanes and the punishments they would suffer for their crimes--a prophecy brought to fruition by Zeus who deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

statement.id: Ouranos menubuatkan kejatuhan para Titan dan hukuman atas kejahatan mereka; Zeus menggenapi nubuat itu dengan menggulingkan lima bersaudara dan melemparkan mereka ke jurang Tartaros.
statement.en: Ouranos prophesied the fall of the Titans and their punishment for their crimes, a prophecy fulfilled when Zeus deposed the five brothers and cast them into the pit of Tartaros.

quote: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art but Egyptian depictions of their sky-goddess Nut demonstrate how he was imagined--as a gigantic, star-spangled man with long arms and legs, resting on all fours

statement.id: Ouranos tidak muncul dalam seni Yunani awal, tetapi penggambaran Mesir tentang dewi langit Nut menunjukkan bagaimana ia dibayangkan: pria raksasa bertabur bintang berlengan dan berkaki panjang yang bertumpu pada keempat anggota badan.
statement.en: Ouranos does not appear in early Greek art, but Egyptian depictions of the sky-goddess Nut show how he was imagined: a gigantic, star-spangled man with long limbs, resting on all fours.

quote: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, in the form of a man holding the zodiac-wheel, standing above the reclining Gaia (Earth).

statement.id: Pada masa Romawi ia sering digambarkan sebagai Aion, dewa waktu abadi, berwujud pria yang memegang roda zodiak dan berdiri di atas Gaia yang berbaring.
statement.en: In the Roman era he was often depicted as Aion, god of eternal time, as a man holding the zodiac-wheel and standing above the reclining Gaia.

quote: According to the writer of the War of the Titans Ouranos (Uranus) was the son of Aither (Aether).
locator: Classical literature quotes: cosmogony of Eumelus

statement.id: Menurut penulis War of the Titans, Ouranos adalah putra Aither.
statement.en: According to the writer of the War of the Titans, Ouranos was the son of Aither.

quote: In Orphism, the world began with Chronos (Time). ... Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.
locator: The Creation of the World According to Orphism

statement.id: Dalam Orfisme, Phanes melahirkan Nyx (Malam), lalu Nyx melahirkan Gaia dan Uranus bersama Phanes.
statement.en: In Orphism, Phanes gave birth to Nyx (Night), and then Nyx bore Gaia and Uranus with Phanes.

quote: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship to Uranus, he does have an Orphic hymn dedicated to him.

statement.id: Meski nyaris tidak ada bukti ibadah kepada Uranus yang bertahan, ia memiliki satu himne Orfik yang dipersembahkan untuknya.
statement.en: Although there is barely any surviving evidence of worship of Uranus, one Orphic hymn is dedicated to him.

quote: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.
locator: Witness to the Oaths of the Gods

statement.id: Uranus bersama Gaia dan Styx sering menjadi saksi sumpah para dewa.
statement.en: Uranus, along with Gaia and Styx, was often the witness to the oaths of the gods.

quote: According to the Theogony, there is an equal distance between Tartarus (the infernal regions), Earth (Gaia), and the heavens (Uranus). Therefore, an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia

statement.id: Menurut Theogony, jarak antara Tartarus, Bumi (Gaia), dan langit (Uranus) sama; sebuah landasan yang jatuh dari Uranus butuh sembilan hari sembilan malam untuk mencapai Gaia.
statement.en: According to the Theogony, Tartarus, Earth and the heavens are equally far apart; an anvil falling from Uranus would take nine days and nights to reach Gaia.

quote: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he, too, would face being overthrown by his son.

statement.id: Uranus kehilangan kekuasaan kepada Cronus tetapi memperingatkannya bahwa ia pun akan digulingkan oleh putranya.
statement.en: Uranus lost power to Cronus but warned him that he too would be overthrown by his son.

quote: A desperate Rhea approached Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her run away to Crete, where Zeus was born.

statement.id: Rhea yang putus asa meminta bantuan Uranus dan Gaia, dan mereka membantunya melarikan diri ke Kreta, tempat Zeus lahir.
statement.en: A desperate Rhea asked Uranus and Gaia for help, and they helped her flee to Crete, where Zeus was born.

quote: After Zeus married his first wife, Metis, Uranus and Gaia informed him that Metis would have a daughter who was strong and wise like her father and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of the gods and men.

statement.id: Uranus dan Gaia memberi tahu Zeus bahwa Metis akan melahirkan seorang putri yang kuat dan bijak serta seorang putra yang akan menggulingkan ayahnya menjadi raja para dewa dan manusia.
statement.en: Uranus and Gaia told Zeus that Metis would have a strong, wise daughter and a son who would overthrow his father to become king of gods and men.

quote: The myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth found in Hesiod's Theogony. Anu, the king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, mitos itu sangat mirip dengan mitos suksesi Uranus-Cronus-Zeus dalam Theogony Hesiod, dan Anu, raja Langit, dapat jelas dikenali sebagai Uranus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the myth closely follows the Uranus-Cronus-Zeus succession myth in Hesiod's Theogony, and Anu, king of Heaven, can clearly be identified as Uranus.

quote: During the 20th-century excavations in the village of Boĝazköy (Turkey), a set of tablets were discovered that recounted the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

statement.id: Tablet yang ditemukan dalam penggalian di desa Boĝazköy menceritakan kisah Het tentang kebangkitan dewa badai Teššub dan upaya menggulingkannya.
statement.en: Tablets found in excavations at the village of Boĝazköy recount the Hittite story of the storm god Teššub's rise to power and the attempts to overthrow him.

quote: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (aka Philo of Byblos, l. 1st or 2nd century CE).

statement.id: Versi mitos suksesi yang dianggap versi Fenisia dicatat oleh Herennius Philo (Philo dari Byblos, abad ke-1 atau ke-2 M).
statement.en: What is considered a Phoenician version of the succession myth is recorded by Herennius Philo (Philo of Byblos, 1st or 2nd century CE).

quote: Together they have a son named Epigeios, who would later be named Uranus, and a daughter called Ge (Gaia). After his father's death, Epigeios (Uranus) replaced him as king and married his sister, Ge.

statement.id: Dalam versi suksesi ini, Epigeios, yang kemudian dinamai Uranus, menggantikan ayahnya sebagai raja dan menikahi saudarinya, Ge (Gaia).
statement.en: In this succession version, Epigeios, later named Uranus, replaced his father as king and married his sister Ge (Gaia).

quote: During the 32nd year of his reign, Cronus emasculated Uranus.

statement.id: Dalam versi itu, pada tahun ke-32 pemerintahannya Cronus mengebiri Uranus.
statement.en: In that version, Cronus emasculated Uranus in the 32nd year of his reign.

quote: it was fellow astronomer Johann Elert Bode (1747-1826) who suggested that it be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity

statement.id: Astronom Johann Elert Bode mengusulkan agar planet itu dinamai Uranus untuk menghormati dewa purba tersebut.
statement.en: The astronomer Johann Elert Bode suggested that the planet be called Uranus in honour of the primordial deity.

quote: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and the third largest of the planets. It was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel (1738-1822)

statement.id: Planet Uranus ditemukan pada 1781 oleh astronom Inggris-Jerman William Herschel.
statement.en: The planet Uranus was discovered in 1781 by the British-German astronomer William Herschel.

quote: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia, the personification of Earth, gave birth to Uranus (Heaven), along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

statement.id: Dalam Theogony-nya, Hesiod (700 SM) menulis bahwa Gaia melahirkan Uranus (Langit) bersama Pontus (Laut) dan Ourea (Pegunungan).
statement.en: In his Theogony, Hesiod (700 BCE) writes that Gaia bore Uranus (Heaven) along with Pontus (the Sea) and Ourea (the Mountains).

quote: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.
locator: The Creation of the World According to Orphism

statement.id: Orfisme adalah gerakan keagamaan yang menonjol pada abad ke-6 SM.
statement.en: Orphism was a religious movement that rose to prominence during the 6th century BCE.

quote: And Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side, and to be an ever-sure abiding-place for the blessed gods.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi pertama-tama melahirkan Langit berbintang, setara dengannya, untuk menutupinya di semua sisi dan menjadi tempat tinggal yang selalu aman bagi para dewa yang diberkati.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth first bore starry Heaven, equal to herself, to cover her on every side and be an ever-sure abiding place for the blessed gods.

quote: But afterwards she lay with Heaven and bore deep-swirling Oceanus, Coeus and Crius and Hyperion and Iapetus, [135] Theia and Rhea, Themis and Mnemosyne and gold-crowned Phoebe and lovely Tethys.

statement.id: Hesiod menulis bahwa Gaia kemudian berbaring bersama Langit dan melahirkan Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe, dan Tethys.
statement.en: Hesiod writes that Earth afterwards lay with Heaven and bore Oceanus, Coeus, Crius, Hyperion, Iapetus, Theia, Rhea, Themis, Mnemosyne, Phoebe and Tethys.

quote: For of all the children that were born of Earth and Heaven, [155] these were the most terrible, and they were hated by their own father from the first. And he used to hide them all away in a secret place of Earth so soon as each was born, and would not suffer them to come up into the light: and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, anak-anak terdahsyat Bumi dan Langit dibenci ayah mereka sejak awal; setiap kali seorang lahir ia menyembunyikannya di tempat rahasia di Bumi dan melarangnya naik ke terang, dan Langit bersukacita atas perbuatan jahatnya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, the most terrible children of Earth and Heaven were hated by their father from the first; as each was born he hid it in a secret place of Earth and would not let it come up into the light, and Heaven rejoiced in his evil doing.

quote: Forthwith she made the element of grey flint and shaped a great sickle, and told her plan to her dear sons.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi membentuk sabit besar dari unsur batu api kelabu dan menyampaikan rencananya kepada putra-putranya.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth made the element of grey flint into a great sickle and told her plan to her sons.

quote: And Heaven came, bringing on night and longing for love, and he lay about Earth spreading himself full upon her. ... Then the son from his ambush stretched forth his left hand and in his right took the great long sickle [180] with jagged teeth, and swiftly lopped off his own father's members and cast them away to fall behind him.

statement.id: Dalam Hesiod, Langit datang membawa malam dan merindukan cinta lalu merebahkan diri di atas Bumi; putranya dari penyergapan memotong anggota tubuh ayahnya dengan sabit panjang bergerigi dan melemparkannya ke belakang.
statement.en: In Hesiod, Heaven came bringing night and longing for love and spread himself upon Earth; his son from his ambush lopped off his father's members with the long jagged sickle and cast them behind him.

quote: for all the bloody drops that gushed forth Earth received, and as the seasons moved round [185] she bore the strong Erinyes and the great Giants with gleaming armour, holding long spears in their hands and the Nymphs whom they call Meliae

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Bumi menerima semua tetes darah itu dan seiring musim ia melahirkan Erinyes yang kuat, para Raksasa berbaju zirah gemerlap bertombak panjang, dan Nimfa yang disebut Meliae.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, Earth received all the bloody drops and as the seasons turned bore the strong Erinyes, the Giants in gleaming armour with long spears, and the Nymphs called Meliae.

quote: But these sons whom he begot himself great Heaven used to call Titans (Strainers) in reproach, for he said that they strained and did presumptuously [210] a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod, Langit yang agung menjuluki putra-putranya "Titan" (Para Penegang) sebagai celaan, karena mereka berbuat lancang suatu perbuatan mengerikan, dan ia berkata bahwa pembalasan akan datang kemudian.
statement.en: According to Hesiod, great Heaven called his sons Titans (Strainers) in reproach, saying they strained and did presumptuously a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards.

quote: However, no cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus does not appear among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

statement.id: Tidak ada kultus yang ditujukan langsung kepada Uranus yang bertahan hingga masa klasik, dan Uranus tidak termasuk tema lazim keramik lukis Yunani.
statement.en: No cult addressed directly to Uranus survived into classical times, and Uranus is not among the usual themes of Greek painted pottery.

quote: is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities. According to Hesiod, Uranus was the son and husband of Gaia (Earth), with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

statement.id: Uranus adalah personifikasi langit dan salah satu dewa purba Yunani; menurut Hesiod ia putra sekaligus suami Gaia, yang bersamanya menurunkan generasi pertama Titan.
statement.en: Uranus is the personification of the sky and one of the Greek primordial deities; according to Hesiod he was the son and husband of Gaia, with whom he fathered the first generation of Titans.

quote: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós

statement.id: Kebanyakan ahli bahasa menelusuri etimologi nama Οὐρανός ke bentuk Proto-Yunani *Worsanós.
statement.en: Most linguists trace the etymology of the name Οὐρανός to a Proto-Greek form *Worsanós.

quote: making Ouranos the "rain-maker", or the "lord of rain".

statement.id: Akar kata Indo-Eropa dasarnya menjadikan Ouranos "pembuat hujan" atau "penguasa hujan".
statement.en: The basic Indo-European root makes Ouranos the "rain-maker" or the "lord of rain".

quote: Of some importance in the comparative study of Indo-European mythology is the contested identification by Georges Dumézil (1934) of Uranus with the Vedic deity Váruṇa (Mitanni Aruna), god of the sky and waters, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.

statement.id: Georges Dumézil (1934) mengidentifikasi Uranus dengan dewa Weda Váruṇa, tetapi persamaan etimologis itu kini dianggap tidak dapat dipertahankan.
statement.en: Georges Dumézil (1934) identified Uranus with the Vedic deity Váruṇa, but the etymological equation is now considered untenable.

quote: He is, however, identified on the Gigantomachy frieze on the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting against the Giants with a sword

statement.id: Uranus diidentifikasi pada relief Gigantomachy di Altar Pergamon, berjenggot dan bersayap, melawan para Raksasa dengan pedang.
statement.en: Uranus is identified on the Gigantomachy frieze of the Pergamon Altar, bearded and winged, fighting the Giants with a sword.

quote: After his castration, Uranus recedes into the background.

statement.id: Setelah dikebiri, peran Uranus surut ke latar belakang.
statement.en: After his castration, Uranus recedes into the background.
